At inside support, allocated density is at most full facet density and the pyramid is inside the full fiber. At outside support, the height and captured volume both vanish. Strictly empty and full fibers have zero allocated coarea. A pure-base cap uses its whole-fiber volumes and no continuous section. Endpoint counting verifies the one-dimensional cases.

Expansion of h minus tau gives the tilt, threshold, and continuous-mark terms with the displayed signs. Capwise base balance and the weighted threshold product, followed by averaged continuous-normal balance, cancel exactly. The full allocated mean supplies both capwise conditions by averaging the plane equation whenever section mass is positive.

The source sections cover the same all-status construction and conditional cancellation. The frozen statement weakens the through-mark condition to its product with allocated coarea, which is sufficient even for zero-coarea caps.

Its limiting coarea law supplies a common allocated mean and continuous balance under specific vanishing-buffer identities. The present statement uses such conditions only as inputs and establishes an all-status pyramid identity even outside that limiting setting.
